product_metadata.title: Tribesigns Vanity Set with Lighted Mirror, Modern Makeup Table with Drawers and Stool, Elegant Dressing Table for Women and Girls (White + Gold)
features: Feel like a movie star before the best performance with this table.The dressing table comes with 8 Hollywood-style LED light bulbs, providing soft and bright lights with an easy control switch. Energy-saving light bulb with long service life, no glare, no eye injury. You’ll get the control over every detail of your hair and makeup whether in the day or night.
With this vanity, you will have enough space to keep your makeup, perfumes, hair tools, and more. Having all of in one place, your room will look sharp and cleaner
The stool has good resilience and won't collapse easily, you can sit comfortably when you are making up.
This vanity also represents the perfect gift to every woman, from your daughter to your wife, because they will be delighted by the elegant and functional vanity.
All the parts will be delivered to your hands in TWO PACKAGES, which you can easily assemble according to the instructions.
